preparation.policy: Apply this frozen measured warm preparation to each treatment endpoint; machine charges are not measured.

privacy: Only selected counters, sanitized checker logs, and candidate patches are exported. No raw streams, model prose, thinking, tool input/results, or init/account metadata.

cost_accounting.note: Known cumulative reports are counted once per run, including failures. Missing or interrupted usage can make this total a lower bound. Machine and engineering costs are not measured.
